identification: Six Australian 1966 round 50c coins (80% silver, about 13.5g each, one-year type), a British Elizabeth II crown in a square capsule (cruciform shields reverse, consistent with the 1953 Coronation crown, cupro-nickel) and a 1988 Parliament House $5 aluminium-bronze coin on its Commonwealth Bank spec card. Value is almost all in the six 50c.
